title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 5: the search for one just man in Jerusalem, the nation from far away, and prophets who prophesy falsely.

questions.text: What was to be sought in the streets of Jerusalem so that Yahweh would pardon her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to seek "if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her."

answers.text: Ten righteous men within the city
A man who does justly and seeks truth
A priest who keeps the law

questions.text: What had the people made their faces harder than?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return."

questions.text: Which animal is said to watch against their cities?
questions.explanation: The verse says a lion will kill them, a wolf of the evenings will destroy them, and a leopard will watch against their cities.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would make his words in Jeremiah's mouth?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them."

answers.text: A hammer, and this people stone
A sword, and this people grass
Honey, and this people bitter herbs

questions.text: What is said about the language of the nation brought from far away?
questions.explanation: It is a mighty, ancient nation "whose language you don't know and don't understand what they say."

answers.text: It sounds like the roaring of the sea
The people do not know it or understand what they say
It is the language of the land of Egypt
It is like the speech of the land of Canaan

questions.text: What is the quiver of that nation like?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men."

questions.text: What has Yahweh placed as the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has placed the sand for the bound of the sea, so that though its waves toss and roar, they cannot pass over it.

questions.text: What does Yahweh give in its season, which the people do not say in their heart to fear him for?
questions.explanation: They do not say, "Let's now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season."

answers.text: Grain, new wine and fresh oil
Snow on the mountains in winter
Rain, both the former and the latter
Dew from the heavens each morning

questions.text: What are the houses of the wicked full of, like a cage full of birds?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit."

questions.text: What astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land?
questions.explanation: The prophets prophesy falsely, the priests rule by their own authority, and "my people love to have it so."

answers.text: The altars are broken down and the appointed feasts have ceased in the land
The prophets prophesy falsely, the priests rule by their own authority, and the people love it
The kings have sold the land and the people to strangers for silver
The children refuse to learn the law and the elders despise correction
